programs.title: It's beautiful here
programs.desc: Dorota Szelągowska will visit unique places in Poland, the existence of which only insiders often know.The host will prove that it is never too late to fulfill your childhood dream and live in a tree house, at least for a while.For those who value greater comfort, he will show luxurious interiors created, among others, by:in an old cotton fabric factory.Viewers will also meet the owners of these charming places, who will tell their stories and reveal how they managed to implement their unique plans and projects.Many of them abandoned life in big cities to be able to do what they love most, i.e. interior design and running unique guesthouses.Dorota Szelągowska will look into every nook and cranny of these original buildings, reveal interior design ideas to viewers and prove that there are many wonderful places in Poland that are truly beautiful.

Dorota Szelągowska visits Pabianice.Thanks to many years of revitalization works, the former building of a cotton fabric factory now houses the "Fabryka Wełny" hotel.The presenter will assess the effect of the designers' efforts, who had to combine modern design with elements reflecting the past of this place.At the same time, they could not forget about comfortable conditions for guests.Then Dorota Szelągowska will try the dishes served in the hotel restaurant and talk to the musicians working there.

programs.title: Unobvious places
programs.desc: Katarzyna Jaroszyńska visits people who breathed new life into very old buildings.When Violetta stumbled upon her future home, it was just a shanty.Despite this, she fell in love with it and began the difficult renovation.Afterwards, she could live in her dream house with blue shutters.Sławek was looking for his place on earth for a long time.He finally realized that it would be best for him to stay in his grandmother's old house.Restored after over 50 years, the building is full of memorabilia from the deceased owner.Milena and Patrick decided to purchase a 19th-century manor and palace complex.The renovation has been going on there for 13 years, but it is already clear that its effects are stunning.

programs.title: Unobvious places
programs.desc: This time Katarzyna Jaroszyńska will visit people whose houses are distinguished by style.Kasia and her husband bought a plot of land in the Bieszczady Mountains and decided to live there as close to nature as possible.The small house belonging to the farm of Jakub and his wife brings to mind American series about prairie inhabitants.Natural elements intertwine with boho accents, and the veranda invites you to spend evenings there with a cup of hot tea.Anna and Krzysztof love Provence.They decorated their caravan on the Baltic Sea in a style reminiscent of this region of France, and now they have managed to create another place smelling of lavender.
